stem:
In 1636, Thomas Hooker . . . established the first English settlement in Connecticut. Convinced that government should rest on free consent, he ________?________.

—Steven Mintz, "Colonization: Dimensions of Change in Colonial New England," Digital History, http://www.digitalhistory.uh.edu (accessed September 12, 2011)
instruction: Which of the following completes the sentence above?

options.label: A
options.text: limited property ownership to church members

options.label: B
options.text: extended voting rights beyond church members

options.label: D
options.text: asked the king to appoint a governor for the colony
